away.summary: The Devils (7-4-0) are on a three-game road trip that began Tuesday in Dallas and continues Wednesday in Colorado. Connor Hellebuyck made his Devils debut Tuesday against the Stars after being acquired from Winnipeg, but with no practice time between games and a back-to-back set, Jake Allen is projected to start in Colorado. Hellebuyck is expected to be involved at some point during the trip.
